products.name: Thorn — Grey Jeans
products.description: White thorn-like linework follows the leg of washed grey, wide-leg jeans. A hand-painted original by Eri Kazui.

products.name: Feather — Blue Jeans
products.description: Pale feather-like brushwork sweeps across light blue flared jeans, following the shape of the denim.

products.name: Lily — Black Hoodie
products.description: Two pink lilies bloom across the back of a black hoodie, with green stems and delicate white accents.

products.name: Wings — Denim Jacket
products.description: A pair of white painted wings stretches across the back of an indigo denim jacket. Detailed feathers follow the seams.

products.name: Serpent — Black Shorts
products.description: A coiled silver-white serpent winds over the back pocket and leg of black shorts. Fine painted scales bring the artwork to life.

products.name: Samurai — Washed Hoodie
products.description: A monochrome samurai mask fills the back of a washed charcoal hoodie, with bold contours and softly shaded armour.

products.name: Koi & Flowers — Indigo Jeans
products.description: Flowing koi and flowers cover dark indigo jeans in white and pale blue brushwork, continuing across the pockets and legs.
